thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: apigw-global elevated 502s in eu-west-2 and ap-south-1 — 5m avg 11% 502. Paging oncall-lina.
oncall-lina: Lina here, ack. what's affected?
eng-sre-matt: Matt (SRE) jumping in. Traces show repeated upstream 'connection_reset' and 'no healthy upstream' from svc-auth and svc-checkout clusters starting ~16:02 UTC.
api-ops-kim: access logs show surge of slow clients -> connection backlog on backend. Noticed a recent iptables rule push to backend nodes at 15:59 UTC. Kim rolling back that change for testing.
infra-sj: checking NIC stats, some nodes showing spike in RST packets. opening hotspot on node backend-22.
customer-success-jan: two enterprise customers reporting failed logins and checkout errors. marking as P1.
oncall-lina: immediate actions: 1) rollback iptables rule on backend pool 2) enable 10% traffic diversion to EU fallback for read-only APIs 3) increase apigw replicas by +4. Assigning tasks.
eng-sre-matt: rolling back iptables now.
```
# rollback iptables rule
ssh admin@backend-22 'sudo iptables-restore < /etc/iptables/rules.backup-before-15-59'
```
deploy-bot: config-manager reports rollback applied to 5/6 nodes.
api-ops-kim: applying region split for read-only flows via traffic-router.
```
traffic-router route-set --service apigw --selector "path=^/api/catalog" --region eu-fallback --weight 10
```
observability-bot: alert suppression applied for noisy rate alerts for this incident. Links: https://telemetry.redwood/alerts/3344556611
eng-sre-matt: scaling apigw now.
```
kubectl -n apigw scale deployment apigw --replicas=14
```
infra-sj: drained backend-22 and found high file-descriptor usage in svc-auth process; restarted service.
eng-sre-matt: after rollback+drain+scale, 502s dropped to 2.3% in 5m window. p95 latency improving.
customer-success-jan: updated customers: "We applied a rollback and traffic routing; service recovery in progress. We'll send follow-up with RCA and ETA."
oncall-lina: keep on monitoring. Who will own postmortem? Matt. Will include config diffs and timeline.
eng-sre-matt: noted. preliminary hypothesis: bad iptables push caused intermittent packet drops resulting in connection resets, leading to gateway 502s during traffic spikes. collecting logs and deploy diffs.
api-ops-kim: will push safer deploy gating to prevent iptables pushes without health validation.
oncall-lina: incident-bot, mark as mitigation stable when metrics stay below 1% for 15m.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: MITIGATION STABLE — apigw 5xx at 0.6% (recent 5m). Auto-close in 1h if stable.
eng-sre-matt: uploading incident artifacts to #postmortems and will schedule RCA. thanks team. :tada:
